title: 地震来了怎么办
subtitle: 趴下、掩护、抓牢
character: wearing a blue hoodie, grey trousers and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, soft charcoal drawing with warm watercolor washes, grainy black lines, cream paper, calm reassuring colors

pages.zh:
我家在加州。
这里的天气很好，院子里有一棵大树。
不过住在这里的人都知道，
地面偶尔会轻轻摇一下。
爸爸说，那叫地震。
pages.scene: A sunny California street with low houses, palm trees and a big tree in the front yard. The little boy stands in the yard looking up at the sky, calm and curious.

pages.zh:
地震是从哪里来的呢？
爸爸说，我们脚下的大地，
不是一整块，
而是由好多块巨大的石板拼起来的。
它们会非常非常慢地挤来挤去。
pages.scene: A simple clear cross-section: under a strip of green grass with one small house on top, four huge flat rock slabs lie side by side edge to edge like floor tiles, filling the underground part of the picture, with small black arrows drawn on the slabs showing them pressing slowly toward each other.

pages.zh:
爸爸拿两块饼干给我看。
他把两块饼干的边对在一起，
轻轻往中间一挤——
饼干先是卡住不动，
然后咔的一声，错开了。
pages.scene: Top-down view of a plain wooden table top with nothing else on it: two square biscuits lie flat side by side, their straight edges touching. One grown-up hand presses the left biscuit sideways toward the right one, and the right biscuit has just slipped a little so the two edges are no longer lined up, with a few crumbs at the join.

pages.zh:
地下的石板也是这样。
它们卡住、卡住，
忽然一滑，
地面就会摇起来。
这就是地震。
pages.scene: A simple drawing of the ground with two rock plates slipping past each other underground, and above them wavy lines spreading out through the soil toward a small house on the grass.

pages.zh:
摇起来的时候，
站着的东西会倒，
放着的东西会掉。
书架上的书哗啦啦地滑下来，
桌上的杯子跳到地上。
pages.scene: Inside a living room during shaking: books sliding off a bookshelf, a cup bouncing off the table, a lamp tilting, motion lines around them, nobody in the room.

pages.zh:
所以，我们要学会一招。
这一招有三个动作：
「趴下、掩护、抓牢」。
只要记住这三个词，
地震来了就不慌。
pages.scene: The little boy stands in the living room holding up three fingers, counting them one by one, a calm and confident face, a sturdy wooden dining table behind him.

pages.zh:
第一个动作：趴下。
地一摇，就马上蹲下来，
手和膝盖着地，趴低一点。
不要站着，也不要往外跑，
跑起来反而会摔倒。
pages.scene: The little boy drops down onto his hands and knees on the living room floor, staying low, a calm face, the dining table right next to him.

pages.zh:
第二个动作：掩护。
钻到结实的桌子下面，
用两只手护住自己的头和脖子。
桌子挡在上面，
掉下来的东西就砸不到我。
pages.scene: The little boy crawls under a sturdy wooden dining table and covers his head and the back of his neck with both hands, looking calm and safe under the table top.

pages.zh:
第三个动作：抓牢。
一只手护住头，
另一只手抓住桌子腿。
桌子要是被摇得移动，
我就跟着它一起动，不松手。
pages.scene: Under the dining table, the little boy holds one hand over his head and grips the wooden table leg tightly with the other hand, looking determined.

pages.zh:
有些地方不能去。
摇的时候不要跑到门口，
也不要上下楼梯，
更不要跑到外面——
外面可能有东西掉下来。
pages.scene: A simple clear picture of a front door standing open and a staircase beside it in an empty hallway, with a bright warning triangle sign drawn in the middle of the picture, no people.

pages.zh:
也不要躲在这些东西旁边：
高高的书架，
大大的电视，
还有挂在墙上的镜子。
它们都可能倒下来。
pages.scene: A living room corner with a tall bookshelf, a big television on a low cabinet and a mirror hanging on the wall, each drawn with a small wobble line beside it, no people in the room.

pages.zh:
今天，我们全家要做一次演习。
妈妈是一位短头发、穿红毛衣的大人，
她站在客厅中间，
拍拍手，大声说：
「地震啦！」
pages.scene: A grown adult woman with short black hair in a red sweater stands in the middle of a living room, clapping her hands once and calling out, her mouth open, nobody else in the room.

pages.zh:
我一听就趴下、
钻到饭桌下面、
一只手护头，一只手抓住桌腿。
然后在心里数：
一、二、三……一直数到十。
pages.scene: The little boy is under the sturdy wooden dining table, one hand over his head and the other gripping the table leg, his lips moving as he counts, a calm face.

pages.zh:
摇完了，也不要马上跑出去。
先穿上鞋子再走，
因为地上可能有碎玻璃。
家里的鞋，
就放在床边最好找的地方。
pages.scene: A pair of small sneakers placed neatly beside a bed on the floor, and a few pieces of broken glass drawn on the floor a little further away, warm quiet light, no people.

pages.zh:
门口还放着一个应急包。
里面有水、饼干、手电筒、
急救包、一件小外套，
还有一条毛巾。
这些东西平时不动，只在地震后用。
pages.scene: Top-down view of an open orange emergency backpack on the floor with its contents laid out neatly beside it: bottles of water, plain biscuit packets, a flashlight, a first aid kit with a white cross, a small jacket and a rolled towel. No writing or letters anywhere in the picture.

pages.zh:
包里还有一张小卡片。
上面写着爸爸妈妈的名字和电话，
还有我们约好见面的地方——
院子里那棵大树下。
走散了，就到树下等。
pages.scene: A small card with a few simple handwritten wavy lines on it lying on the floor next to the emergency backpack, and beside it a simple drawing of a big tree in a yard with a circle around it, warm light, no people. No writing or letters anywhere in the picture.

pages.zh:
有一天晚上，我正在刷牙。
忽然，杯子里的水晃了一下，
吊灯也轻轻摇起来——
真的地震了！
我一点也没有愣住。
pages.scene: Evening in a small bathroom: the little boy stands at the sink holding a toothbrush, looking up at a ceiling lamp that is swinging gently, the water in a cup rippling, his eyes wide but not frightened.

pages.zh:
我马上趴下，
钻到旁边的桌子下面，抓牢。
摇了一会儿就停了。
爸爸妈妈跑过来抱住我：
「你做得真好！」
pages.scene: The little boy comes out from under a table and his parents kneel down and hug him: the mother is a grown adult woman with short black hair in a red sweater and the father is a tall grown adult man in a grey shirt, all three smiling with relief, warm lamp light.
